function.name: smart_home
function.description: Control or check the home: lights, colour, brightness, music, volume, thermostat, timer, alarm, reminders, phone call, message. One call per command. Intents that need a slot, and its form: BRIGHTNESS: a percentage, like '40 percent'; COLOR: any colour, like 'purple' or 'warm white'; TEMPERATURE: degrees, like '24 degrees'; TIMER: a duration, like '45 minutes' or '1 hour 30 minutes'; ALARM: a clock time, like '6:30 AM' or '7:15 PM'; CREATE_REMINDER: what to be reminded of, in the user's words; CALL: a contact name from the phonebook; MESSAGE: a contact name from the phonebook. Phonebook: Anna (sister), Ben (brother), Mom (mother), Dr. Reyes (dentist), Carlo (friend). Every other intent takes no slot.

slot.description: The value for BRIGHTNESS, COLOR, TEMPERATURE, TIMER, ALARM, CREATE_REMINDER, CALL or MESSAGE, in the form listed. Omit for other intents.

say.description: One short sentence said to the user the moment this call starts, saying what you are doing (like 'Checking the weather.'); never the result.

function.description: Search the document collection about the life and works of the novelist Cormac McCarthy and return the best-matching passages with their source file. Use it for any question on that topic and answer from the passages. Write the query as a short self-contained question.
